rationale.intuition: Penn State overall accept ~60%; GPA 3.8 / SAT 1400 strong-mid profile, competitive CS major, RD. **2026-05-31 48-flagship audit correction: Penn State's own CDS shows in-state 60.56% ≈ out-of-state 59.24% — residency is NOT priced (PA carries no in-state multiplier; the prior 2026-05-24 fixture's 'PA in-state preference' premise was empirically wrong, it relied on the old flat-1.2 default).** Without a residency lift this resolves to a strong MATCH (~0.55) at a competitive CS program, not a residency-driven safety. (Separately surfaced, not fixed here: whether the stats boost should lift a >75th-percentile applicant higher at high-accept schools — a strong-stats-vs-safety calibration question independent of geography.)
